Definition: Kemosh, the god of the Moabites
BiblicalUsage: Chemosh = "subduer"; 1) the national deity of the Moabites and a god of the Ammonites; 1a) also identified with 'Baal-peor', 'Baal-zebub', 'Mars' and 'Saturn'; 1b) worship of this god was introduced into Jerusalem by Solomon and abolished by king Josiah of Judah
